verdict.rationale: BigQuery's first-party docs state that query jobs embed diagnostic query plan and timing information, comparable to EXPLAIN in other systems, which is the core of diagnosing slow queries. Community reports add that dry runs and pre-run bytes-scanned estimates help explain query cost. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of per-stage breakdowns (slot time, shuffle, skew), a visual execution-graph UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the plan to troubleshoot slow queries.
